# PageLabelStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Numbering style for a page label section, mapping to the PDF /S entry.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Decimal`: Decimal Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3, …). PDF /D.
- `LowercaseRoman`: Lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii, …). PDF /r.
- `UppercaseRoman`: Uppercase Roman numerals (I, II, III, …). PDF /R.
- `LowercaseAlpha`: Lowercase letters (a, b, c, …, aa, bb, …). PDF /a.
- `UppercaseAlpha`: Uppercase letters (A, B, C, …, AA, BB, …). PDF /A.
